source_kind: Playwright 读取社区 Wiki 普通呈现页;不是 Raw API,也不是实机抓取。
note: minetip_text 保留 Wiki 属性中的原始 & 颜色码、/ 换行、反斜杠转义及 HTML 实体;转换时先解实体再处理颜色,只拆未转义的 /。对白 raw 由明确的 format-* 类还原。page.dialogue 保留前缀与 Wiki 参数标记,不能直接当作运行时模板。条件列仅是来源旁注,不据合并单元格猜测新剧情。tooltips 用内容哈希去重;menus 引用完整有文本格子(不含空白装饰格)。本档案不打入 Mod。
limitations: Banker Barry 页面没有对白,只记录 NPC 身份及银行与全部内嵌子菜单。
St. Jerry 年内重复领取礼物的对白含破损 sic HTML;不据残句恢复未确认拼写。
Generow 的 (gifts} Unique Gifts! Wow! 参数标记破损,仅保留档案待实机核对。
Frozen Alex 的电话对白在 Wiki 中缺少姓名/冒号;档案保留原貌,运行时复用既有去前缀后的台词,不把坏前缀写入语料。
Jerry 页面还包含私人岛屿/搁浅/花园对白和通用设置等菜单;全量采集以免遗漏,不等于本轮全部补译。
页面内嵌的子菜单全部保留。商店右键批量交易及购买确认等未展示的状态,不能声称 Wiki 已覆盖。
BossBar/Sidebar/ActionBar 只有零散玩法叙述及图片,缺少可靠带色完整文本;保留库内已有实机模板,本轮不由机制描述编造 HUD。
配方关联材料及商城宠物皮肤等在档案中也会出现;不代表这些都来自工坊掉落。附魔书只收本玩法出现的附魔,不展开全游戏附魔。

dialogue.raw: §e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: 'Tis the §cSeason of Jerry§f, §b[player]§f!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: You may have noticed some §aGifts§f laying around.
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: Each SkyBlock year, I place them throughout the village to spread joy and good tidings.
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: Find them all and come back to me!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: Find all of the Gifts around the village and come back to me!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: I see you've found some Gifts, but there are still many more in the village. Find the rest and come back for a reward!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: You're getting there, §7[player]§f! Find the rest of the Gifts and come back for a reward!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: You're so close! Find §a# §fmore Gifts and come back to me!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: You're so close! Find the last Gift and come back for a reward!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: You found all of the Gifts!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: Take this §aGreen Gift§f! You'll hopefully find something nicer than what was in those White Gifts!
§e[NPC] §c St. Jerry§f: If you haven't already, be sure to give your other Gifts away to others. Giving Gifts benefits both you and the receiver!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: §b✆§f Of course I can add you as a contact!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: §b✆§f I have §c# contacts §fon my Abiphone.
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: §b✆§f It's a really big Abiphone!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: §b✆§f If you want my contact, all you have to do is repeat this phrase exactly...
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: §b✆§f "§bI love the warmth of the Holidays despite the snow"
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: §b✆§f That's grandiose!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: §b✆§f I really like you!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: §b✆§f Call me every year and I'll hand you a White Gift!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: §b✆§f I sent a gift to your inventory! With love, St. Jerry.
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: §b✆§f You've already recieved[sic<
§fabbr>]<
§fsup> a gift this year!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: §b✆§f But hey, merry season of the Jerry to you anyway!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: §b✆§f Call me again next year!
§e[NPC] §9St. Jerry§f: Golly gee - I want to spread joy around the world, in the form of raw materials!
§e[NPC] §9St. Jerry§f: Your help has been the greatest gift of all.
§e[NPC] §9St. Jerry§f: Without your help, I can only supply plain white gifts this holiday.
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: Did you know you can access your Bank from Jerry's Workshop? Check out the Bank in the center of the village!
§e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: Click someone with a Gift to give both you and them a Gift!

dialogue.raw: §e[NPC] §cSt. Jerry§f: Come back next SkyBlock year to find more Gifts!
